name: A10-0120/2026 – Stéphanie Yon-Courtin – After § 42 – Am 7
title: REPORT on the impact of the implementation of Directive 2014/89/EU, the Maritime Spatial Planning Directive, on fisheries in selected fishing areas and sea basins
part_text: 42a. Calls for the EU and its Member States to prohibit fishing vessels over 25 metres in length from fishing within EU waters up to 12 nautical miles from the baselines in order to safeguard coastal fishing communities and conserve marine biological resources and ecosystems;
